description: A parenthesized static map key is not a static traversal
notes: In an object key the spec gives parentheses a meaning beyond grouping: {(foo) = "baz"} takes its key from the variable foo, while a bare foo is a literal name. So (b) is the key form that refers to a variable, which a static traversal needs, but the spec doesn't say whether the parentheses stop it being a variable expression for static analysis. hashicorp/hcl splits keys the other way: parseObjectCons (hclsyntax/parser.go) marks a key that starts with a parenthesis ForceNonLiteral, so ObjectConsKeyExpr.AsTraversal (hclsyntax/expression.go) gives no traversal, while a bare identifier key gives one.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
